title: Document Processing & Information Extraction Pipeline
description:
Many teams still type data from PDFs, scans and photos into their systems by hand: invoices, contracts, forms. The goal is a pipeline that reads these documents automatically and returns structured data that other systems can use.

Requirements

  • Formats: PDFs with a text layer, scanned PDFs and images (PNG, JPG, TIFF).
  • Extraction: OCR plus field extraction (parties, dates, amounts, invoice numbers, line items).
  • Document types: recognize invoices, contracts and other documents and apply the right extraction.
  • Validation: check completeness and consistency (for example subtotal + tax = total) and send doubtful documents to a person.

The pipeline has to handle high document volumes reliably, and some organizations need it to run without sending documents to a cloud service.
goals:
• At least 95 % of key fields extracted correctly on a labelled sample of real documents.
  • Less than 10 seconds processing time per document.
  • Throughput of 1,000+ documents per hour.
  • PDF, PNG, JPG and TIFF supported; every document that fails a check is flagged for review instead of passed on.
